title: Masonry Blocks - Dimensions
description: Concrete Masonry Unit Blocks (CMU) - dimensions and specifications for standard and half blocks.

components.content:
## Standard Blocks

Typical dimensions for standard concrete masonry unit blocks.

### Nominal vs Actual Sizes

Standard blocks have a nominal height of 8 inches and length of 16 inches, with varying widths.

## Half Blocks

Half blocks are used for partial course heights and corners. They have a nominal height of 8 inches and length of 8 inches (half the standard length).

## Notes

- Actual sizes account for typical mortar joint spacing (approximately 3/8 inch)
- The difference between nominal and actual size allows for standard mortar joint thickness
- Use the complementary tool to calculate the number of masonry units needed for a project
